items.title: 一度作れば，ゲーム開発はずっと続けていけるのか。創作，生存，持続をテーマにインディー開発者3名が本音で話すセッションをレポート［BIC2026］
items.summary: 核となるのは，ゲーム開発をしたら，ずっと開発を続けられるのか，という問いである。異なる理由でゲームを作り始めた3組の開発者が登壇し，創作（CREATE），生存（SURVIVE），持続（CONTINUE）の3セクションに沿って，来場者から事前に募集された質問に答えていった。

zh.title: 一旦你创造了一个游戏，你能永远继续开发它吗？报道三位独立开发者诚实地谈论创造、生存和可持续发展主题的会议 [BIC2026]
zh.summary: 核心问题是，一款游戏开发出来之后，还能继续开发吗？三组出于不同原因开始制作游戏的开发者上台，分三个部分回答参观者提前提出的问题：CREATE、SURVIVE 和 CONTINUE。

en.title: Once you create a game, can you continue developing it forever? Report on a session where three indie developers spoke honestly on the themes of creation, survival, and sustainability [BIC2026]
en.summary: The core question is, once a game is developed, can it continue to be developed? Three groups of developers who started making games for different reasons took to the stage and answered questions solicited in advance from visitors in three sections: CREATE, SURVIVE, and CONTINUE.

It is a practical content with concrete anecdotes.

items.title: 主人公は戦わない。「Ratopia」のCassel Gamesが次に作る「Ratocalypse」は，ゾンビだらけのネズミ王国で兵士の行動条件を設計するRPG［BIC2026］

zh.title: 主角不打架。 《Ratocalypse》是Cassel Games的《Ratopia》的下一款作品，是一款在充满僵尸的老鼠王国中设计士兵行为条件的角色扮演游戏[BIC2026]

en.title: From Xbox to PS5: The evolution of the original Halo

In 2011, "Halo: 10th Anniversary Edition" was released on the Xbox 360 console. It was a replica full of flaws. In order to make up for the shortcomings, players relied on their own efforts and serially updated the "SPV3" replica campaign MOD with richer content from 2012 to 2019. On July 28, 2026, "Halo: Battle Evolved" was officially released on PC, PS5 and Xbox Series S/X. This time it was reprinted using Unreal Engine 5. "Campaign Evolved" is the first time the "Halo" series has landed on Sony's console platform. It is also the game with the best graphics and the most auxiliary function options in the series. Whether you are an old player who has persisted from the original "Halo" or a new player who is coming into contact with the series for the first time, "Campaign Evolved" is a masterpiece worth trying. ■

en.title: What is "thermodynamic computing" that aims to save power by using "thermal noise", which was the enemy of computers, in reverse?

These random fluctuations are called ``thermal noise,'' and are suppressed in normal computers because they cause disturbances in calculations, but research is progressing on ``thermodynamic computing,'' which uses this thermal noise for calculations instead. It is possible that the processing necessary for AI and scientific calculations can be executed with less power consumption and heat generation than conventional computers, but at the time of writing the article, the principle is being verified using small-scale prototype machines and simulations. read more...

en.title: Approximately one-third of ``sterilized'' ink for tattoos and permanent makeup is contaminated with bacteria, including pathogens that can cause infections.
en.summary: Tattoos, in which the skin is incised with a needle and soaked with ink, are widely accepted as a form of fashion and self-expression. In recent years, permanent makeup for beauty purposes has also become popular, using special needles to embed pigment into the skin and draw eyebrows and eyeliner. However, when the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) investigated 259 tattoo inks and permanent makeup inks (PMU), it was found that approximately one-third were contaminated with bacteria, even if they were labeled as ``sterilized.'' read more...
